scripts.text: Erm, how can I get the hair? By hunting Matte Drainliars?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Why, do you want to quit magic and turn to thievery?

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: No. But it's always been my dream to conquer all the dungeons on the continent and become the greatest mage.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: ...That's a big dream, an impossible dream. Well, anyone can dream big.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Even if it's not for my dream, a cloaking cape will come in handy in various situations.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: I didn't know there was an aspiring thief among us. Huh.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: I said that's not what I want. Adventurer, are you busy?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: What, you're going to ask him? Do it yourself!

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: I have other things to do.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Like what? Eating, sleeping, and pooping?

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Oh, come on! You know I've been busy studying things!

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: You mean, studying me and Dracula.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: ...How did you...?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: I've known that from the beginning. Your face is so transparent, you can't hide anything. I just didn't say anything because I found it funny that you nervously kept glancing at us.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: ...Oh. Then can I ask you questions?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Adventurer, are you going to get the bat hair for him? Good, that means you'll take care of those Matte Drainliars. Their flapping their wings keep me awake at night.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Why can't you do it yourself? All you have to do is just flick your finger.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: I can flick my finger at you if you want.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Adventurer, please bring me the bat hair. King, I mean, Mr. King, how much bat hair do I need?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: That depends on what kind of cape you want. Just know that it's tough to make stuff with hair.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Um, okay, then please bring me ^0000cd20 Short Bat Hairs^000000 for starters.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: While you're at it, hunt the ^0000cdMatte Drainliars^000000 around us. There are at least ^0000cd10^000000.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Happy hunting, Adventurer!

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: You came back quickly. I hope you didn't forget anything.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Wizard! The adventurer has brought the hair.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: What am I supposed to do now?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: That's for you to figure out. I'm not a cape maker, am I? But I know you would need more than that.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Um... Adventurer?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: He just came back from hunting. You should let him rest, at least for the rest of the day.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Adventurer, come back tomorrow and hunt more Matte Drainliars for me, will you? It's so quiet without them.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Th-then see you tomorrow, Adventurer...

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: You came back quickly. I hope you didn't forget anything.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Look what we've got here. Did you forget what I asked? I told you to ^0000cdhunt 10 Matte Drainliars and bring 20 Short Bat Hairs^000000.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Go get it done.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Are you sure you can carry all that stuff? Why don't you lighten your bag?

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Aww, my wounds are fully healed, but I'm still in pain.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: How's Mojo doing? Heh, she's so curious, I feel sorry for Brother Grimm for having to deal with her.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: I can't leave here just yet. There are still many things in this place I want to know about.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: King has smelled blood. Even though that's how he found me when I was bleeding to death, it still scares me that he can do that.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: A fight has broken out somewhere over there. Don't you want to go check?

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: I'm going to stay here for a while. It'll take for a while before Dracula fully regains his energy, and personally, there are many things that I want to know about these people.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Please let Nun Gem and Mojo know.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Adventurer, see this luminous glow over here? It's from the shining spores you brought to me.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: I feel as if I traveled back in time, studying by this dim light.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: I still have enough light left in these shining spores. Please come back after dawn.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Adventurer! You are the light of my life!

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: You're scaring him.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Could you get me shining spores again today?

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000cd10 Shining Spores^000000 from Neon Mushrooms and ^0000cd10 Clusters of Nightmares^000000 from Sweet Nightmares. Thank you.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Adventurer, wait!

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: You misspelled that.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Where? Oh, I did it again.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Tsk, tsk. I don't know how you've become a wizard when you can't even spell correctly.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: This is only because it's too dark to see. And stop peeking at what I'm doing!

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: It's not like you're writing something important.
You two get along as well as I remember.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: What are you doing here? Don't you have things to do?
Jojo wanted to see me.
Actually, I'm busy.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Are you? I was going to ask you a favor, but I can wait.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Then you'd better go attend to your business.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Why?

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Since we're underground, it's too dark for me to write and read. I have a lot of information that I want to catalog, but I keep misspelling words because I can't see them clearly.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: You should be able to do that with your eyes closed. You're a wizard. Didn't you learn how to summon light? But of course, if you use magic in front of me, I'll burn you to ashes.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: I completed my guild's official wizard training program. I'm strong enough to have a contest with you!

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Oh, really? Good for you!

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Be honest, though. Did you really study hard? Did you attend every class, study all night, and practice hard? You'd better tell me the truth.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Can you honestly say that you tried to push past your limits?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: No, you didn't. That's why you had your butt handed to you by those mushrooms.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: I said they were zombies, not mushrooms!

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Zombies and mushrooms. Same difference to me.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: You're not good enough to earn your keep. I can't believe your guild actually invested in you.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Then what about you? I know you can transform. But what else can you do?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Maybe you keep questioning me because you can't trust me. How about I teach you to be the greatest mage among humans? Would you trust me, then?

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Erm, you want to teach me?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Sure.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Why?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: I've studied a lot. Why do you think I have?

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: To become smarter?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: No. Because I was bored to death!

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: You have all the time in the world. I'm envious of that.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: If you don't want me to teach you, that's fine by me.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: No, no! I'd love to! But, erm, you're not going to ask for my blood in return, are you?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: *Snort* If I drink anything because I'm hungry, I wouldn't be any better than those Matte Drainliars now, would I?
Jojo?

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to keep you standing there. Could you get me some spores from Neon Mushrooms? I need some light to see what I'm writing.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Oh, you know how those spores glow. I want to use them to illuminate this place.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Well, then go get them yourself. Don't dump things on this adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Oh, well... I'm... Neon Mushrooms are... You know.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Where are you going to put the spores, anyway?

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: I have an empty bottle? oh, I forgot I lost my bag when I was attacked.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Adventurer, could you get me some Clusters of Nightmares as well? I can mix them with the spores to make a paste and apply it on the wall.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: What? That's so tacky.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: But effective nonetheless. You didn't know you could use them like that, did you?

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: Because I didn't need to.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Then, Adventurer, please bring me ^0000cd10 Shining Spores^000000 from Neon Mushrooms and ^0000cd10 Clusters of Nightmares^000000 from Sweet Nightmares.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Adventurer, welcome back!

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: I can tell that's not enough, just by looking at it.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Oh, you're right. You must have forgotten what I asked.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000cd10 Shining Spores^000000 from Neon Mushrooms and ^0000cd10 Clusters of Nightmares^000000 from Sweet Nightmares. Thank you.

scripts.speaker: King
scripts.text: I can tell he brought everything you asked. Come on, make a paste and apply it to the wall already.

scripts.speaker: Jojo
scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you for helping me study. These glowing spores don't last long. Could you come back tomorrow and get me more of them?
This orb needs more time to gather enough energy before it'll work.
^4d4dffYou must be level 120 or higher to enter this area.^000000
^ff0000I feel dazed, as if I'm dreaming.^000000
I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
I have all the twigs I need. I should go back to Zeith and Vrid.
I checked the mound of dirt to look for twigs.
There's nothing inside this mound of dirt.
I've found 1 ^006400Dry Twig^000000.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text: Um.. Are you an adventurer?? I have a favor to ask you...

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
...Oh, you need more experience. Excuse me.
It's a high risk job.
- ^0000CDLevel 150 and over can do this quest.^000000 -
What's going on?
I'm very busy.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
Sorry to bother you.
God bless you.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
Sorry for the sudden request.
I am from the Alberta Guard of the 1st Knights Division, Knight Aylvar.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
Under the command of the Knights, I am on a mission to search for Alberta's 2nd Knights Division, who had disappeared in Turtle Island.
However, after meeting a violent storm, I arrived at a Turtle Island, but it didn't seem like the normal Turtle Island.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text: I was in danger, but someone helped me out.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text: As I woke up, I felt the sea breeze from Alberta's harbor... In my hands, two pieces of this turtle shell.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
Here is only one piece I have right now.
My friend might have the other one. No, I mean he must still have.
Is your friend in trouble?
It's unbelievable.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text: I understand. Even for me, I am bewildered, but please hear me out. I think my friend is in danger

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text: Yes, it's about my friend. Sorry for such a long story, just a little more, hear me out.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
I show these pieces to my friend, ^0000CDLeiphen^000000.
He shows big interest. ^0000CDHe said that it was made from the shell of a turtle living only on Turtle Island.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
After I handed the pieces to him....
My friend Leiphen who was looking at the pieces suddenly disappeared.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
It happened ^FF0000half a day ago^000000.
In the meantime, I contacted Juno University and went to Turtle Island, but I haven't achieved any results... I was hoping I could find a clue so I figure out where Leiphen disappeared to.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
{0}, please help us. Can you help me find my friend?
This piece might be a clue. Please take a look.
Please tell me your friend looks like.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text: ^0000CDHe wears glasses^000000 and has blue short hair. ^0000CDHis face is just like a scholar^000000 so you should be able to recognize him.
Show me the piece. Let me take a look.
Sorry but I'm busy.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
Sorry to bother you.
God bless you.
- ^424242EStopped handing the piece over.^000000 -

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text: I am sorry, {0}. You already have too much stuff. I figure it's difficult to find my friend right now.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text: Can you clear up your inventory a little bit? I will be right here waiting for you.
- ^424242I grabbed the piece handed over by the knight. A small leaf is carved on the turtle shell. It's a bulky piece, but somehow feels warm.^000000 -
- ^424242I was looking at the piece for a while, but suddenly something seemed to appear in my head. Suddenly a gust blows and my vision gets darker.^000000 -
- ^424242EAylvar's voice is getting smaller and I felt dizzy. It's starting to smell like wet clay....^000000 -

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text: {0}! Oh, you are ok! I am... worried. After Leiphen, {1}, you also disappeared, I was really concerned.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text: Are you going back to find Leiphen again?
Let me go there again.
I will go there later.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
Please save Leiphen.
If I can go there, I will save him myself.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
Thank you. Thank you so much.
Please save Leiphen.
- ^424242As the girl who was there told me, I squeezed the piece of the turtle shell, I felt the wind blowing my hair again.^000000 -
- ^424242Before my eyes were completely dark, my cheeks felt the cooler air from the cave....^000000 -

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
Hi {0}. I have heard every story from Leiphen.
I am worried because he went there again. He said he would come back after finds out the secret of that place.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
Not only Leiphen but also a kid named Narin... who you also helped. You are a great adventurer.
Are you going there again?
Yes. I am going there.
Not right now.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text: Oh, since you are going there again, please make sure Leiphen is ok as well.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
Please come back again, {0}.
On the way, please make sure Leiphen is doing good.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
Glad to see you again. I have reported the information to the Knights Division and now my job is to support Leiphen's research.
Are you going there again?
Yes. I am going there.
Not right now.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text: When I heard his story, I wanted to go there too... but I can't do as he explained. I am so sad.

scripts.speaker: Knight Aylvar
scripts.text:
Please come back again, {0}.
If you find Leiphen, please make sure he is eating.
- ^424242Beyond the door, it appears black, and nothing seems to exist. A reddish glow is floating in front of the black sky. A nervous looking girl appears.^000000 -

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
...It is this place.
Hopeless, desperate, and poisonous.
- ^424242It's a puzzling response, but it might help. As the girl told me, I held onto the turtle shell.^000000 -
Back to Alberta.
Stay here.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: ......Not going to back?
- ^424242The smell of salty wind lifted the hem of my clothing. You can hear the waves of Alberta Harbor and the sound of seagulls....^000000 -
- ^424242This red light is invisible to Narin. It just seems to disappear.^000000 -
- ^424242If I don't come back, she will forget. Just right before I walk into the light, Narin's voice echoed from behind me.^000000 -

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: I will remember... Come back. Please. Bro...!
Nod and go to Alberta.
Nod and turn.
- ^424242Turning around with a small smile, Narin, holding her hands, was surprised and glanced over.^000000 -

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: Ah? Not going back?

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: Hey!
- ^424242I nodded and recalled the bulky piece I had now kept by my heart. The sea breeze from the harbor blows by my ears...^000000 -
- ^424242Now I stand in front of the familiar light. Lightly waved my hand to Narin, she closed her eyes and held both hands together.^000000 -
- ^424242With empty hands, I think of the bulky but warm piece left in my heart.^000000 -
Go back to Alberta.
Stay here.
- ^424242Turning around with a small smile, Narin, holding her hands, was surprised and glanced over.^000000 -

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: Ah? Not going back?

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: Hay!
- ^424242I will come back again. I put my hands together on my chest.^000000 -
- ^424242The consciousness became far away, and the salty, slightly fishy smell of Alberta Harbor tickled my nose.^000000 -

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: What are you doing with such a heavy bag? Clear some out.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
Again... Stranger.
And you brought that again.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: You have a lot of questions, but no need to know.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
But ^0000CDthere is someone here like you^000000. One who shouldn't be here.
Go back with ^0000CDa scholar who has blue hair^000000. Do you know him?
I am here to find him.
Do you know Archeologist Leiphen?

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
Good. I don't know his name and where he is, but I can guess.
^0000CDThere are two locations^000000. Go find and take him. And do not come back.
Ok, but I have some questions.
How can I believe you?
Let me know the way to go back.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: You will be gone for good. No need to know.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
A spell that will protect you for a moment.
It will follow you around. Curiosity killed the cat. Don't look into something that is unclear. Don't look back, or talk behind someone's back.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: ^FF0000Don't be alarmed that you may breathe strangely.^000000

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: I don't know. I don't know where you came from, how could I know?

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: However, there, the empty door... might have something, you might know about.
- ^424242The girl glanced toward the back of where she was standing. Looking closely, it seems that something reddish is floating in front of the black hole. Let's go and look.^000000 -

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: Go back. It's dangerous here.
- ^424242The girl said briefly and stopped talking. She looks sad....^000000 -

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: ...You, still alive?

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: Before you get in danger, get the person you were looking for and leave.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
You are safe. Both of you.
...Sorry for the danger.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
Then, go back. To the place you came.
And forget everything.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text:
Huh? What do you mean? I will come back again.
Until I find out all of the secrets here.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
Why do you ignore my warnings? Arrogant.
You may be a professor but that does not give you the right to walk around here.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text:
......Do you know something?
Please tell me. Where am I? What just happened here?
Stop saying that.
You are the arrogant one.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: Stop? I didn't say anything wrong. You are going to leave and forget everything soon. You will never come back.... right?

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: ......Fine. Arrogant or not. Think freely. I don't care anyway.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: I said before.... but no one has returned. I am not expecting anyone to.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: ......No one comes back. It's better to not come here. It's full of danger.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text: You want that, but still someone is going to come back here.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: Ok. Fine. Let me tell you. Promise me you will go back after listening. It's not like I want to talk a lot.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: ...Give me a sec. I need time to think clearly. It's been a long time not talking....

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: I'll talk to you again after a while.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
Thank you for waiting...
It would be better to start introducing myself. I am Narin. ^0000CDOld Ghost.^000000

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
You look like you have been through a lot of things before. I can see you are able to talk normally.
Ordinary people like a professor can't even see us.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: All the residents here are spirits bound by the burden of resentment. When you're dead, obsessed with something you desperately want, and you'll always do the same thing without realizing it..

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
We hate life. Those who are not bound by the burden of resentment, those who breathe strangely. We want to hear your last breath.
But unless you realize us, we cannot realize you either. It's a good thing.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
It doesn't last long. The longer you stay here, the more you notice each other. Gradually.
And suddenly you guys realize. That's strange. ...Then, it's over.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: The professor got my stuff, so I could recognize it right away. Normally I wouldn't have known.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text:
Oh, I knew it...!!
It was you who saved Aylvar. Thank you for helping my friend!

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
I wanted to do it.  My obsession is...
^0000CDU I don't want anyone get die here. I want to save all life.^000000......
It was just that.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
Oh... really, it's such a silly story. It's hard to keep talking.
Just leave me alone for a while? Sorry for taking so long.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text: It's ok. I'll leave you for a moment. {0}, let's go together.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: Thank you for waiting. I'm good now. Let me finish.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: It's not the first time, someone is here. It's a rare event. When I first saw someone, I remembered what I wanted.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
The man was deathly afraid, but he was alive and left this place.
After that... I could stay a little longer.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: It's been a while, I haven't lost my mind. I was not swept away by resentment and neither reason nor emotion was lost.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
So I want to save all life. Those who have flowed in and even those trapped by the burden forever.
I realized that all those I saved went back to where they came from.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
It's... it's hard. Even I envy those trapped by this burden. But... I couldn't turn it off. The people who are in danger.
....
But I don't want to hope. If you hope... you can be betrayed.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
Oh, I almost forgot. Let me cast my spell on you again. It's weak, so it will not last long.
Just get out before it's over.
It's been hard on you being alone.
I am not going back.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
......I didn't tell you the long story to hear that...
Please don't care about me....

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text: {0}, it turns out that you speak very well.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
What are you talking about?! I said go back after you listen to my whole story...!
I don't want to worry anymore!

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text: Yes. That's what I wanted to say.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: What do you mean...?

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text: Let us help other souls here like you, Narin, resolve themselves.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
Oh really...
......No, it was a coincidence. They are, not like me.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text: We will see. Right?

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
It's ok. I will forget both of you. All the souls here are made like that.
I might remember a little longer. But I forget eventually.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text: We can guess one fact. All the lost memories are in the subconscious mind of Narin.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text: I will come back. For research and for you, Narin.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: Really... Really? Are you going to come back here and find me?

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: I don't need to be ... alone...?
I won't leave you alone.
Don't worry.
I promise.
I will come back.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: ......Thanks...

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: Thanks... Really...

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text:
Hu? Huh? It's just gone. The {0}.
Suddenly from my hands... like it melted away.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: It has my wishes. Now... It doesn't need to exist.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: ...I, I don't know the specifics reason... Just that it might be that way.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: ...Oh, right. Here... I give this to you. Here, you too professor.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
It's a sign of promise. I will try to remember the two of you. So come... come and find me.
Tomorrow, and the day after tomorrow... I'll be waiting... Brother and professor.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: And the others... you said you would help them. I'll show you how. How you can help...

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
^0000CDListen to what they want. Brother, even if you look very trivial, do something they'll be pleased by.^000000
Please... Maybe one day...
Don't worry. I will.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
I, I was able to stay alone so far, because I could meet you two again someday?
I will... remember... Please... come back.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist Leiphen
scripts.text:
I will be here until I find all of the secrets.
Don't worry. {0} and myself will not forget about you Narin.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
I asked you to come back... but you must leave today. It's dangerous to be here any longer.
There is a limit to the protection spell.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
The day is over and you two stay together. I'll give you a new spell.
If I forget again... Please I will try to remember...

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: Brother... Are you still here? The spell will be gone after a day, please come back after dawn.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text: Even if I forget you brother, don't go away...please.

scripts.speaker: Narin
scripts.text:
Again... Stranger.

scripts.text: Um... Uhm...

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Oh, what a surprise!!

scripts.text: What's up? I'm busy right now, so I'll talk to you later.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Um... Uhm...

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Oh, what a surprise!!

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: What's up? I'm a bit busy right now...

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text:
Ah, you're the one introduced by Raket. I've been waiting for you.
Can you show me your fishing rod?
- Jerrymon began to examine the rod closely. -

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Yes, that's right... this substance is just that... to discover it again like this...
What material are you talking about?

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Adventurer, do you know where the deepest part of the sea is?
Well...??

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: It is a place called the ^4d4dffTrench^000000. To put it simply, you can think of it as a deep cliff in the sea.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: It is known that there are hundreds of different types of trenches in the world's oceans.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: The widest and deepest known trench is the ^4d4dffBahia Trench^000000 near Izlude.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: There are rare life forms at the bottom of the trench, and marine scientists like myself have shown great interest and have been exploring them.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Though shallow trenches can be explored to some extent.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: But in the case of the Bahia Trench, scientists have calculated that scientifically, no life can exist because it is so incredibly deep.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: I recently found out that there is life in the Bahia Trench.
How do you know that??

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: You can tell by the stone that contains my magic.
A stone with magical power?

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Yes, I'm a mage-turned-oceanographer. I learned magic for oceanography.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Enchant a large boulder and make it fall to the floor where the trench exists.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: The magic on the dropped stone is connected to me, so by measuring the distance, I can get a little idea of how deep it is and what's going on near the stone.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: To tell you what I found out...

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: The composition of normal sea water and deep sea water is almost the same. But the only difference is the deep sea of Bahia Trench.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Should I say it's like water and oil? There's a section where they never mix.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: A strong boundary was formed where they meet each other, and it felt as if the deep seawater in that section was desperately blocking the seawater coming down from above.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: The water pressure is also much lower than that of normal seawater, so it is assumed that it has a favorable environment for life.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: We call it ^4d4dffdeep seawater^000000
Is this gloss related to what you said?

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text:
Yes! That's right!!
We only identified the existence of Abyssal Seawater deep in the Bahia Trench, and it was very difficult to obtain samples. This fishing rod has a lot of Abyssal Seawater on it...

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Could you leave this fishing rod with me? I think I can figure something out if I extract this sea water and turn it into essence.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Oh, and I heard that the fishing rod was found today. Can I ask you to check if there is another floating substance in the nearby sea?
Okay, I'll be back.
I'm a bit busy right now...

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Please come back to me when you're done!

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Yes, thanks! I'll be waiting for you!!

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text:

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: See those two little water bottles here?

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: One side is normal seawater, and the other side is seawater mixed with seawater from the abyss buried in fishing rods. I'll try mixing these two.
- Jerrymon poured both waters into one bottle and began to shake them together. -

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Now, look. As I said before, they don't mix at all, do they?

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: This... this!!

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: If you shake it like crazy!!

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Wow!!!!!!

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Uwachachaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!!!

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Ahhhhhhh!!!!!!

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Keep... Whoa... Whoa... OK now.
- Looking into the bottle Jerrymon is holding, I can clearly see the shape of the vortex. -

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Now, do you see this whirlpool!! This is the passage that connects to the bottom of the Bahia Trench!
??? Isn't that just a whirlpool created by shaking it?

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: No. This is the stone that contains my magical power. Let's look at it.
- Jerrymon put a glowing stone into the bottle. The glowing stone was sucked into the whirlpool inside the bottle and disappeared without a trace! -
No, how could it be?

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Did I ever tell you that the stone that contains my magic can measure the distance to me?

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text:
It feels the same as the last time I threw a pebble into the Bahia Trench..
If you follow this whirlpool, you may be able to find the owner of the fishing rod.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: The problem is... the amount of essence on a fishing rod can't make a whirlpool large enough for a person to fit in.
Is this amount okay?

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: Oh, just in case, I actually found it!

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text: With this amount, I think I can create a vortex of fissures that normal people can enter. You can pass it to me.

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon
scripts.text:
The place is too small to do this much here, so let's do it in Izlude. In order to get help from your friends.
Then see you in Izlude!!

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon

scripts.speaker: Jerrymon

scripts.text: Hello, my name is Soup, a friend of Sirood who is missing.

scripts.speaker: Soup
scripts.text: The four of us, Sirood, Raket, Gein, and I often enjoyed fishing.

scripts.speaker: Soup
scripts.text: That windy day... I had been feeling very guilty for not stopping Sirood from going fishing.

scripts.speaker: Soup
scripts.text: When I heard that Sirood's fishing pole was found, I jumped out.

scripts.speaker: Soup
scripts.text: You must have a clue about something?

scripts.speaker: Soup
scripts.text: I did my best.

scripts.speaker: Soup
scripts.text: Should Sirood come back safely?

scripts.speaker: Raket
scripts.text: Thank you so much!!

scripts.text: Oh, hello...

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: This fishing rod belongs to my friend Sirood who went missing three months ago. I found something!!!
Disappeared?

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Yes... Sirood is a fishing fanatic and came here to fish whenever he had a chance.

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Influenced by Sirood, we also fell in love with fishing, and the four of us often had a good time.

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Sirood's passion for fishing was to the point that he invited us to go fishing even in the rain and wind.

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: The day Sirood went missing was exactly the same rainy and windy day. I put on my raincoat and went to go fishing.

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: We were invited to go out together, but they all declined.

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Sirood went fishing alone and we haven't seen him since...

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: I should have stopped you from leaving...
- Gein started talking again after wiping away tears for a moment. -

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: The news of Sirood's disappearance immediately spread throughout Izlude and a large-scale search was conducted with a lot of time and manpower invested, but the search ended without finding any clues.

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: After that, we got together and ran everywhere to find Sirood, but there was no result, and we were about to give up.

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: But just now!!

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: After 3 months!!!

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Sirood's fishing pole has risen above sea level. His item was nowhere to be found during the search!
Now, calm down... Are you sure it's Sirood's fishing rod?

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Yes, I'm sure! It's the fishing rod I've always seen.

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: This fishing rod was made by Sirood himself, so it is the only one. You can see the initials on the handle here, S.R.D!!
Oh, then why now...

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: I'm so surprised and shocked right now that I don't know what to do.

- But looking closely at the fishing rod, I feel something different. This wooden fishing rod has been submerged in water for 3 months, but it still looks the same, and I can see a bit of shiny gloss... -
Isn't this fishing rod a bit strange over there?

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Strange, what is it?

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Uh...

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: It's been submerged in water for 3 months... but it hasn't corroded at all. It's completely fine??

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Hmm... And it seems to have a subtle glow... It seems like the fishing rod is coated?
-The person who seemed to be Gein's friend who was listening to the story opened his mouth. -

scripts.speaker: Raket
scripts.text: Where is it, I want to see it!! What's wrong??

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: This fishing rod... It was submerged in the water for 3 months, but it was found in its original form, or worse, in a state of disrepair.

scripts.speaker: Raket
scripts.text: Ugh...

scripts.speaker: Raket
scripts.text: Um...
- Raket looked intently at his fishing pole, then answered Gein. -

scripts.speaker: Raket
scripts.text: I'm not sure either?

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Certainly!! I don't know, but would you?

scripts.speaker: Raket
scripts.text: Ummm... but I know someone who might know a little about this rod.

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Who??
Who?

scripts.speaker: Raket
scripts.text: His name is Jerrymon, a marine scientist. I've met my father a few times. I know you are in the East Library of Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Ah, ah... then... hey adventurer!! I'm sorry for the first meeting, but can I ask you a favor?? We can't get out of here in Izlude...

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Please go see Jerrymon and show him this fishing rod...even if it's trivial...I hope he has some information..
Okay. Let's go.
Sorry. I'm a bit busy right now...

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: No... are you sure?

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Are you turning around after hearing about this heartbreaking story and mysterious clue...

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Ugh... Thanks!

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: ^4d4dffJerrymon^000000 should still be at the <NAVI>[East Library]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Now, I'll give you the fishing rod, a keepsake from Sirood. Thank you...

scripts.speaker: Raket
scripts.text: What??? It's a keepsake!! You don't even know if Sirood is alive or dead!!

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Uhhh... yes I made a mistake, this is the fishing rod Sirood left behind. Please take good care of it.

scripts.speaker: Raket
scripts.text: I'll tell Jerrymon about the contents in advance through my father!

scripts.speaker: Gein & Raket & Soup
scripts.text: Thank you!!!

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Take care of yourself!! I hope there is even the smallest clue...

scripts.speaker: Gein

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Ah... I see, I've never heard of a trench before.

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: I can't believe there's such a big and deep trench near Izlude...

scripts.speaker: Gein
scripts.text: Oh, by the way, is there anything else you need for coming back here?
I was wondering if there was anything else found besides the fishing rod.

scripts.speaker: Gein
